items.title: Over a domain, flatness of a finite type algebra and of a finite flat module forces finite presentation
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The proposition records that over a domain, flatness upgrades finite type to finite presentation for the algebra and finiteness to finite presentation for a flat module over a finite type algebra (statement lines 4209-4218). The first part is quoted as a special case of a lemma, while the second chooses a polynomial presentation of the algebra, applies the module version of the same result over the polynomial ring, and descends along the quotient. The reduction to the polynomial ring and the descent are the substance, so the claim is H2.
